papers.title: AltRA-Test: An Alternative Annotator Test for LLM Judges Without Shared Annotators
papers.abstract: Statistical test for deciding when LLMs can replace human annotators, comparing inter-annotator agreement in resampled mixed human-LLM panels; about 100 items often suffice.

papers.title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
papers.abstract: A fixed set of steering vectors added to a frozen diffusion transformer recovers most RL post-training reward gains, suggesting a constant shift drives much of the improvement.

papers.title: Training Vision Models for LLM-Driven Weight-Space Programming
papers.abstract: Edit-Ready Training prepares vision networks so LLMs can edit their weights more successfully than with standard or gradient-based editable training.

papers.title: Online Mistake Detection in Instruction-Conditioned Procedural Video
papers.abstract: Online detector for egocentric video that checks actions against task instructions as they unfold, classifying mistakes such as slips, corrections, and modified steps.

papers.title: Twice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era
papers.abstract: Measures rising critique overlap across peer reviews at ICLR and other venues, finding LLM-flagged reviews of the same paper are less distinct from each other.

papers.title: Accord: Universal Online Metric Localization and Dense Mapping from one Camera and an IMU
papers.abstract: Builds online dense metric maps from one camera and an IMU by anchoring depth predictions to VIO-triangulated points and fusing submaps in a factor graph.

papers.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
papers.abstract: A 27B model diagnoses its own failures and edits its weights without gradients or training, becoming more accurate on problems it never saw during the study.

papers.title: Direct3D-V3: Latent-Free Diffusion Transformers in the Native Voxel Domain
papers.abstract: A diffusion transformer that drops the VAE and models raw SDF voxel grids directly for 3D generation, aiming to remove the reconstruction bottleneck and add local detail.

papers.title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
papers.abstract: Local agents select tools by answering compiled multiple-choice questions rather than generating text, avoiding invented values and reaching 97.0% accuracy on biomedical tasks.

papers.title: Phantom Success, Silent Failure: Auditing the Success Checkers of Simulated Manipulation Benchmarks
papers.abstract: An LLM-based pipeline, SimAudit, audits simulated robot benchmark success checkers against task instructions, finding 61 defects including false successes and false failures.

cc_updates.body:
What's changed

* Added a trust dialog warning that says where a folder's hooks are declared
* Added a warning in the conversation, in Claude Desktop and other non-interactive hosts, when hooks in managed settings fail to load
* Added this session's scheduled tasks, `/loop` wakeups, the goal and this conversation's forks to `/tasks`; x stops one after asking
* Added a "Server message" row to a server's page in `/mcp` that shows the JSON-RPC error message of a remote HTTP MCP server that refuses the connection
* Added a "Marketplace auto-update" row to `/status` that names...

What's changed

* Added auto mode for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude apps gateway; interactive sessions with no permission mode start in it
* Added "onFailure": "block" for `mcp_tool` hooks, as for command and HTTP hooks: a hook whose call fails blocks the action
* Added a warning when a message from a session that skips permission prompts may be held and dropped by a cloud session
* Added a notice in `/status` and `claude doctor` when an OpenTelemetry exporter has no endpoint and its data would likely be lost...

What's changed

* Added a confirmation before `/install-github-app` changes a repository
* Added `claude mcp add-json <name> -` to read the server's JSON from stdin, so tokens can stay off the command line; not available inside a Claude Code session
* Added a line when a resumed session's earlier messages can't be loaded
* Added a list in `/status` of broken agent, skill, command and output style files, keybinding errors, an unavailable sandbox, ignored permission settings and hook matchers that never match
* Added a note in `/config` when other settings override a row
